comments.author: @antipode18
comments.text: The 1992 cod moratorium completely rewired life out there — generations of fishing families had to reinvent themselves overnight, and somehow the culture survived it. Add the Viking history on top of that and Newfoundland has layers most places can only dream of. Do the smaller outport communities actually feel like they're recovering, or is the population still draining toward St. John's?
